title: psyllium arborescens subsp. maderensis
intro: Psyllium arborescens subsp. maderensis, commonly known as Madeiran psyllium or Maderense psyllium, is a plant species within the genus Psyllium that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of constipation due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Psyllium arborescens subsp. maderensis include its demulcent and bulk-forming properties, which help to soothe and protect the mucous membranes, promoting healthy bowel movements. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
